title: Attention Maps Know When to Think: Training-Free Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought for Reasoning Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard reasoning strategy in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), showing strong performance in complex vision-language tasks such as reasoning segmentation. However, our analysis reveals that indiscriminate CoT usage can lead to degraded performance by inducing unnecessary reasoning, a phenomenon we term overthinking. In reasoning segmentation, overthinking often leads to misalignment between the query's intent and visual grounding. To address this, we propose Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT), a training-free adaptive framework that selectively triggers CoT based on the input's intrinsic difficulty. We find that the entropy of the model's attention maps reliably reflects task difficulty: low entropy indicates confident, localized grounding, while high entropy suggests uncertainty and potential benefit from CoT. DA-CoT uses this entropy signal to determine whether to apply

translated_title: 注意力图谱知道何时思考：用于推理分割的免训练难度感知思维链
translated_abstract: 思维链提示已成为多模态大语言模型中的标准推理策略，在推理分割等复杂视觉-语言任务中展现出强大性能。然而，我们的分析发现，不加区分地使用思维链会因引发不必要的推理而导致性能下降，我们将这一现象称为“过度思考”。在推理分割中，过度思考往往导致查询意图与视觉定位之间的错位。为解决这一问题，我们提出了难度感知思维链，这是一个免训练的自适应框架，能够根据输入的内在难度选择性地触发思维链。我们发现模型注意力图谱的熵可以可靠地反映任务难度：低熵表示模型具有置信且集中的定位，而高熵则表示不确定性，此时应用思维链可能带来收益。DA-CoT利用这一熵信号来决定是否应用（思维链推理）……
tldr: 提出免训练的难度感知思维链框架DA-CoT，利用模型注意力图谱的熵作为难度信号，自适应地决定是否触发思维链推理，从而避免过度思考带来的性能下降，提升推理分割效果。
en_tdlr: DA-CoT is a training-free difficulty-aware framework that uses attention map entropy as a signal to adaptively trigger chain-of-thought reasoning, avoiding overthinking and improving reasoning segmentation performance.
